title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 1,551–1,600 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: Renting a modern apartment near an MRT station is convenient.
examples.zh: 在捷運站附近租一間現代化公寓非常方便。

examples.en: She shared a three-bedroom apartment with two college friends.
examples.zh: 她與兩位大學朋友合租了一間三房公寓。

examples.en: The landlord decorated the apartment with hardwood floors and bright lighting.
examples.zh: 房東用實木地板與明亮的照明裝潢了這間公寓。

examples.en: Taipei 101 is an iconic skyscraper building in East Asia.
examples.zh: 台北 101 是東亞地區指標性的摩天大樓。

examples.en: The historic red-brick building was converted into an artistic community cafe.
examples.zh: 這棟歷史悠久的紅磚建築被改造成了一間充滿文藝氣息的社區咖啡館。

examples.en: Fire safety drills are conducted in the office building twice a year.
examples.zh: 辦公大樓每年進行兩次消防安全疏散演練。

examples.en: Minsheng Community is a pleasant, tree-lined residential area.
examples.zh: 民生社區是一處綠樹成蔭、環境宜人的優質住宅區。

examples.en: Speed limits are strictly enforced inside quiet residential areas.
examples.zh: 寧靜的住宅區內部對行車速限實施嚴格執法。

examples.en: Commercial retail shops are strictly separated from the residential area in this district.
examples.zh: 在這個都市分區中，商業零售商店與住宅區被嚴格劃分開來。

examples.en: Many families move to the quiet suburbs for larger living spaces.
examples.zh: 許多家庭為了更寬敞的居住空間而搬至寧靜的郊區。

examples.en: Commuting from the northern suburbs to downtown takes about forty minutes.
examples.zh: 從北部郊區通勤至市中心大約需要四十分鐘。

examples.en: Suburban neighborhoods often feature spacious private yards and quiet parks.
examples.zh: 郊區社區通常擁有寬敞的私人庭院與安靜的公園。

examples.en: The landlord agreed to replace the old air conditioner.
examples.zh: 房東答應幫忙更換老舊的冷氣機。

examples.en: We signed a contract directly with the property landlord without broker fees.
examples.zh: 我們直接與房屋房東簽約，省去了仲介費手續費。

examples.en: A kind landlord gave the tenants a discount during difficult economic times.
examples.zh: 一位善良熱心的房東在經濟不景氣期間主動給予房客租金折扣。

examples.en: Tenants are required to pay rent by the fifth of every month.
examples.zh: 房客必須在每月五號前繳納房租。

examples.en: Prospective tenants toured the newly renovated loft apartment on Saturday.
examples.zh: 準房客們在週六參觀了這間剛翻修完畢的挑高閣樓公寓。

examples.en: Landlords must give tenants sufficient advance notice before inspecting the property.
examples.zh: 房東在前往視察房屋前必須給予房客充分的提前通知。

examples.en: How much is the monthly rent for this two-bedroom suite?
examples.zh: 這間兩房套房每個月的租金是多少？

examples.en: We decided to rent a compact car to explore the coastal highway.
examples.zh: 我們決定租一輛小型掀背車來暢遊濱海公路。

examples.en: The sudden rent increase forced the small bakery to relocate to another street.
examples.zh: 突如其來的租金調漲迫使這家小烘焙坊搬遷至其他街道。

examples.en: We signed a one-year apartment lease with the homeowner.
examples.zh: 我們與屋主簽署了一年的房屋租賃契約。

examples.en: The commercial retail lease expires at the end of next month.
examples.zh: 該商業店面租約將於下個月底正式到期屆滿。

examples.en: The company agreed to lease high-end office photocopiers from the supplier.
examples.zh: 該公司同意向供應商長期租賃高階辦公影印機。

examples.en: Tenants typically pay two months' rent as a security deposit in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣，承租房屋通常需預付兩個月租金作為押金。

examples.en: The security deposit will be fully refunded after the move-out inspection.
examples.zh: 在完成遷出交屋檢查後，押金將會全額退還。

examples.en: Any unpaid utility bills will be deducted from your security deposit.
examples.zh: 任何未清繳的水電瓦斯雜費將從您的押金中直接扣抵。

words.definition: 水電瓦斯費；公用事業費

examples.en: Are water, electricity, and gas utilities included in the monthly rent?
examples.zh: 水費、電費與瓦斯等公用事業雜費有包含在月租金內嗎？

examples.en: Public utilities worked tirelessly to restore electrical power after the typhoon.
examples.zh: 公用事業單位在颱風過後不知疲倦地搶修以恢復供電。

examples.en: Smart home monitoring systems help households optimize their monthly utilities spending.
examples.zh: 智慧家庭監控系統有助於各家庭最佳化每月的公用事業水電開銷。

examples.en: Turn off the air conditioner to reduce your summer electricity bill.
examples.zh: 出門隨手關閉冷氣以節省夏天的電費帳單。

examples.en: Our electricity bill doubled during the July heatwave.
examples.zh: 在七月的熱浪酷暑期間，我們的電費帳單翻了一倍。

examples.en: You can set up automatic bank transfers to pay your bimonthly electricity bill.
examples.zh: 您可以設定銀行自動轉帳代繳每兩個月一期的電費帳單。

examples.en: You can pay your bimonthly water bill at any convenience store.
examples.zh: 您可以在任何一家便利商店繳納每兩個月一期的水費帳單。

examples.en: A sudden spike in our water bill alerted us to a hidden underground pipe leak.
examples.zh: 水費帳單的突然暴增提醒了我們地下可能存在隱蔽暗管漏水。

examples.en: Conserving water with low-flow fixtures helps lower your household water bill.
examples.zh: 使用低流量節水省水裝置有助於降低家庭水費開銷。

examples.en: Check the natural gas meter reading before paying the gas bill.
examples.zh: 繳納瓦斯費帳單前請先核對天然氣瓦斯表度數。

examples.en: Frequent hot baths and cooking caused an increase in our winter gas bill.
examples.zh: 冬天頻繁泡熱水澡與烹飪煮飯導致我們的瓦斯費帳單有所增加。

examples.en: Tenants can scan the invoice barcode with a smartphone to clear the gas bill.
examples.zh: 房客可以用智慧型手機掃描帳單條碼來繳清瓦斯費。

examples.en: The building maintenance fee covers 24-hour security and elevator upkeep.
examples.zh: 社區大樓管理費涵蓋了 24 小時保全及電梯維護保養。

examples.en: Residents voted to raise the monthly maintenance fee to renovate the exterior facade.
examples.zh: 住戶投票表決調高每月社區管理費，以翻新大樓外牆立面。

examples.en: Check whether the apartment rental price includes the community maintenance fee.
examples.zh: 請確認該公寓的租屋標價是否已包含社區管理費在內。

examples.en: The building security guard helps residents collect package deliveries.
examples.zh: 社區大樓保全警衛協助住戶代收網購包裹。

examples.en: The night security guard patrols the commercial complex every two hours.
examples.zh: 大夜班保全人員每兩小時巡邏一次商業綜合大樓。

examples.en: A vigilant security guard noticed the suspicious trespasser and phoned the police.
examples.zh: 警覺的保全人員注意到了可疑的非法闖入者並立即報警。

examples.en: The licensed real estate agent showed us three rental apartments.
examples.zh: 領有執照的房仲帶我們看了三間待出租的公寓。

examples.en: A skilled real estate agent helps negotiate the best purchase price for homebuyers.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的房地產經紀人協助購屋者協商出最理想的買進價格。

examples.en: We consulted a local real estate agent to evaluate the market value of the house.
examples.zh: 我們諮詢了在地房仲以評估這棟房屋的市場行情價值。

examples.en: The studio comes fully furnished with a bed, desk, and wardrobe.
examples.zh: 這間獨立套房配備齊全，附有床鋪、書桌與大衣櫃。

examples.en: Renting a furnished apartment saves exchange students from buying heavy furniture.
examples.zh: 承租附家具的公寓能讓外籍交換生免於添購厚重家具之苦。

examples.en: The stylishly furnished living room features Scandinavian designer sofas.
examples.zh: 裝潢時髦附家具的客廳擺放著北歐風設計師沙發。

examples.en: We bought our own appliances because the flat was unfurnished.
examples.zh: 因為這間公寓是未附家具的空屋，所以我們自己添購了家電。

examples.en: Unfurnished properties generally offer lower monthly rents than furnished ones.
examples.zh: 未附家具的空屋通常比附家具的房屋提供更實惠的月租金。

examples.en: Moving into an unfurnished house gives you complete freedom to choose decor.
examples.zh: 搬進一間無家具的空屋讓你能完全自由地挑選專屬風格裝潢。

words.definition: 獨立套房；攝影棚；工作室

examples.en: Renting a cozy studio apartment suits single young professionals.
examples.zh: 租一間溫馨的獨立套房非常適合單身青年上班族。

examples.en: The painter set up her art easel inside a naturally lit rooftop studio.
examples.zh: 畫家在採光自然充沛的頂樓工作室架起了繪畫畫架。

examples.en: The band spent three days in the sound recording studio laying down vocals.
examples.zh: 樂團在專業錄音室待了三天專心錄製主唱人聲。

examples.en: The apartment building has a community rooftop garden for residents.
examples.zh: 這棟公寓大樓頂樓設有供住戶休憩的社區空中花園。

examples.en: We enjoyed watching fireworks from the hotel rooftop lounge on New Year's Eve.
examples.zh: 跨年夜我們在飯店頂樓露天酒吧欣賞璀璨煙火秀。

examples.en: Solar panels were installed on the rooftop to generate clean electricity.
examples.zh: 屋頂上安裝了太陽能光電板以產生綠色清潔電力。

examples.en: We hung our freshly washed laundry to dry on the breezy balcony.
examples.zh: 我們將剛洗好的衣物晾在通風涼爽的陽台上。

examples.en: She grows potted herbs and cherry tomatoes on her sunlit apartment balcony.
examples.zh: 她在陽光充沛的公寓陽台上栽種盆栽香草與聖女小番茄。

examples.en: Step out onto the balcony to enjoy the magnificent mountain view.
examples.zh: 步出陽台，盡情飽覽眼前雄偉壯闊的青山美景。

examples.en: Do not leave shoes and personal clutter in the shared public hallway.
examples.zh: 請勿將鞋子與私人雜物堆放在公共走廊上。

examples.en: Students gathered in the school hallway chatting excitedly between periods.
examples.zh: 學生們在下課時間齊聚在學校走廊上熱烈聊天。

examples.en: The motion-sensor lights illuminate the hotel hallway as you walk past.
examples.zh: 當你走過時，感應式吸頂燈會自動照亮飯店長廊。

examples.en: The local community center offers free exercise classes for seniors.
examples.zh: 在地社區活動中心為長輩提供免費的銀髮族健身課程。

examples.en: Neighborhood meetings are held monthly inside the district community center.
examples.zh: 里民大會每月在行政區社區活動中心內定期召開。

examples.en: Volunteers organized a blood donation drive at the municipal community center.
examples.zh: 志工們在市立社區中心籌辦了一場愛心捐血活動。

examples.en: Beitou Public Library is famous for its eco-friendly green wooden architecture.
examples.zh: 北投公共圖書館以其環保綠建築木造設計而聞名遐邇。

examples.en: The public library provides free high-speed internet and quiet study carrels.
examples.zh: 公共圖書館提供免費高速網路與安靜的獨立自習隔間座位。

examples.en: Parents often bring young toddlers to the public library for weekend story hours.
examples.zh: 父母親經常在週末帶著幼兒前往公共圖書館參加繪本說故事時間。

examples.en: Taipei district sports centers feature indoor swimming pools and gyms.
examples.zh: 台北市各區國民運動中心均配備室內游泳池與健身房。

examples.en: You can book an indoor badminton court at the public sports center online.
examples.zh: 您可以在線上預訂公立國民運動中心的室內羽球場。

examples.en: The sports center offers affordable yoga, spinning, and aerobics group lessons.
examples.zh: 國民運動中心提供價格實惠的瑜伽、飛輪與有氧舞蹈團體團課。

examples.en: Children love the slides, swings, and sandbox at the neighborhood playground.
examples.zh: 小朋友們喜愛社區遊樂場裡的溜滑梯、盪鞦韆與沙坑。

examples.en: The school playground is open to the public on weekends for recreational sports.
examples.zh: 學校操場遊戲場在週末對外開放，供大眾休閒運動。

examples.en: Soft rubber mats were installed beneath playground swings to prevent injuries.
examples.zh: 兒童遊樂場盪鞦韆下方鋪設了柔軟橡膠防護地墊以防受傷。

examples.en: Remember to wash and recycle plastic bottles and aluminum cans.
examples.zh: 記得將塑膠瓶與鋁箔罐清洗乾淨後進行資源回收。

examples.en: Many clothing brands now recycle plastic waste into eco-friendly fabrics.
examples.zh: 許多服裝品牌現在將塑膠廢棄物回收再製為環保機能布料。

examples.en: The city provides dedicated bins to recycle clean paper, cardboard, and metals.
examples.zh: 市府設置專用回收桶，以回收乾淨紙類、厚紙板與金屬製品。

examples.en: Taiwan is recognized worldwide for its outstanding recycling rate.
examples.zh: 台灣以其卓越傑出的資源回收率享譽全球。

examples.en: Deposit empty glass bottles into the blue designated recycling container.
examples.zh: 將空玻璃瓶投入指定的藍色資源回收桶中。

examples.en: Teaching children the importance of recycling fosters good environmental stewardship.
examples.zh: 教導孩子資源回收的重要性有助於培養良好的環境保護責任感。

examples.en: Taiwanese residents line up with yellow bags when the garbage truck plays music.
examples.zh: 垃圾車響起音樂時，台灣居民會提著專用垃圾袋排隊倒垃圾。

examples.en: The cheerful tune of 'A Maiden's Prayer' signals the arrival of the garbage truck.
examples.zh: 《少女的祈禱》歡快悅耳的名曲旋律預告著垃圾車即將到來。

examples.en: Dedicated city sanitation workers empty bins into the compacting garbage truck.
examples.zh: 辛勤的清潔隊員將垃圾桶倒入具壓縮功能的垃圾車內。

examples.en: Daily waste separation into trash, recyclables, and food scraps is compulsory.
examples.zh: 每日將廢棄物分類為一般垃圾、資源回收與廚餘是強制性的。

examples.en: Clear waste separation signs help office staff sort materials accurately.
examples.zh: 清晰明確的垃圾分類標誌幫助辦公室員工精確分類各類廢棄物。

examples.en: Implementing strict waste separation guidelines significantly reduces landfill volumes.
examples.zh: 落實嚴格的垃圾分類指引能顯著減少送往垃圾掩埋場的垃圾量。

examples.en: Deposit raw vegetable peels and leftovers into the kitchen food waste bin.
examples.zh: 將生菜皮與剩飯菜倒入廚餘回收桶中。

examples.en: The municipality converts collected food waste into organic compost for local farms.
examples.zh: 市政府將回收收集的廚餘轉化為有機堆肥，供在地農場使用。

examples.en: Planning grocery meals thoughtfully prevents unnecessary kitchen food waste.
examples.zh: 妥善規劃每週食材採買能避免產生不必要的廚房剩食廚餘。

examples.en: An authorized technician came to service our gas water heater.
examples.zh: 原廠維修技師前來檢修保養我們的瓦斯熱水器。

examples.en: The laboratory technician carefully analyzed the blood serum samples.
examples.zh: 醫檢實驗室技術人員仔細分析了血液血清樣本。

examples.en: Contact an IT support technician if you encounter computer network errors.
examples.zh: 若遇到電腦網路設定錯誤，請聯繫 IT 技術支援人員。

examples.en: Call a certified plumber immediately to inspect the burst water pipe.
examples.zh: 立即打電話請合格的水電工來檢查破裂的水管。

examples.en: The experienced plumber used an auger snake to unclog the bathtub drain.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的水電技工使用通管條疏通了浴缸的排水管道。

examples.en: The plumber charged a reasonable fee for replacing the leaking toilet valve.
examples.zh: 水電師傅更換漏水的馬桶進水閥僅收取了合理的工本費。

examples.en: The electrician rewired the circuit breaker box safely.
examples.zh: 電工技師安全地重新配置了總配電箱電路。

examples.en: Only hire a qualified licensed electrician to install high-voltage equipment.
examples.zh: 僅應聘請合格領有執照的甲級電匠來安裝高電壓設備。

examples.en: The electrician diagnosed why the kitchen power outlets suddenly lost electricity.
examples.zh: 水電電工排查診斷出了廚房插座為何突然無預警斷電。

examples.en: The bathroom ceiling began to leak water after the typhoon downpour.
examples.zh: 颱風豪雨過後，浴室天花板開始出現漏水現象。

examples.en: If you smell gas, open the windows immediately and check for a leak.
examples.zh: 如果聞到瓦斯味，請立即打開所有窗戶並檢查是否有氣體洩漏。

examples.en: Confidential financial information was leaked to investigative journalists.
examples.zh: 企業高度機密的財務資訊遭人洩漏給了調查記者。

examples.en: The kitchen sink pipe is clogged with food grease and debris.
examples.zh: 廚房流理台水管被食物油脂與菜渣雜物給堵塞了。

examples.en: Traffic was heavily clogged along the highway due to an overturned truck.
examples.zh: 由於一輛貨車翻覆，高速公路沿線交通嚴重癱瘓回堵。

examples.en: Pouring boiling hot water and vinegar can sometimes clear a clogged drain.
examples.zh: 倒入熱滾水與白醋有時能疏通輕微堵塞的排水管路。

examples.en: Turn off the bathroom sink faucet tightly after washing your hands.
examples.zh: 洗完手後請務必將洗手台水龍頭緊緊關閉。

examples.en: The plumber replaced the old corroded brass faucet with a modern stainless steel model.
examples.zh: 水電工將生鏽腐蝕的舊銅水龍頭更換為現代不鏽鋼款式。

examples.en: Water dripped slowly from the leaky faucet all night long.
examples.zh: 整個晚上水滴不停地從漏水的水龍頭中滴滴答答漏出。

words.definition: 水槽；流理台；洗手盆；下沉

examples.en: Rinse the dishes thoroughly in the stainless steel kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 在不鏽鋼廚房水槽中將碗盤徹底沖洗乾淨。

examples.en: Heavy ships will sink beneath the waves if hull integrity is compromised.
examples.zh: 若船體結構完整性受損，沉重的船隻將沉入波濤之中。

examples.en: He washed his tired face with cool water over the porcelain bathroom sink.
examples.zh: 他在瓷製浴室洗手台前用清涼的冷水洗了洗疲憊的臉龐。

examples.en: Press the dual-flush button to save water after using the toilet.
examples.zh: 使用完馬桶後按下兩段式節水沖水按鈕。

examples.en: Clean the ceramic toilet bowl with a disinfectant brush regularly.
examples.zh: 定期使用消毒清潔刷清洗陶瓷馬桶內壁。

examples.en: The restaurant restroom provides clean toilet seat sanitizing wipes.
examples.zh: 餐廳洗手間貼心備有乾淨的馬桶坐墊消毒擦拭巾。

examples.en: Clean fallen hair from the shower floor drain regularly.
examples.zh: 定期清理淋浴間地板排水孔上的掉落毛髮。

examples.en: Heavy rainfall overwhelmed the municipal street storm drains.
examples.zh: 傾盆暴雨讓市區街道的雨水下水道排水系統不堪重負。

examples.en: Continuous stress and overwork will completely drain your physical energy.
examples.zh: 長期持續的壓力與超時過勞會徹底耗盡你的體力與精力。

examples.en: The water supply pipe was upgraded to durable stainless steel.
examples.zh: 自來水供水管線已升級為耐用不鏽鋼材質。

examples.en: Freezing winter temperatures can cause uninsulated outdoor water pipes to burst.
examples.zh: 寒冬嚴寒低溫可能會導致缺乏保溫的戶外自來水管破裂。

examples.en: The old grandfather sat quietly smoking tobacco from a carved wooden pipe.
examples.zh: 老爺爺靜靜地坐著，抽著雕刻精美的木製菸斗。

examples.en: Replace incandescent bulbs with energy-efficient LED light bulbs.
examples.zh: 將傳統白熾燈泡更換為節能省電的 LED 燈泡。

examples.en: A sudden bright idea popped into his head like a lit light bulb.
examples.zh: 一個靈光乍現的絕妙好點子宛如點亮的燈泡般瞬間躍入腦海。

examples.en: Unscrew the burnt-out light bulb only after turning off the wall switch.
examples.zh: 關閉牆壁電源開關後，方可旋下燒壞的鎢絲燈泡。

examples.en: The landlord agreed to replace the worn-out living room sofa.
examples.zh: 房東同意更換客廳那張磨損老舊的沙發。

examples.en: Artificial intelligence will assist professionals rather than completely replace human empathy.
examples.zh: 人工智慧將扮演輔助專業人士的角色，而非完全取代人類的同理心。

examples.en: Remember to replace the smoke detector battery once every year.
examples.zh: 請記得每年定期更換一次火災煙霧偵測器的電池。

examples.en: Can you fix the dripping faucet in the master bathroom?
examples.zh: 你能把主臥室浴室滴水的水龍頭修好嗎？

examples.en: The software engineers deployed an emergency patch to fix the security flaw.
examples.zh: 軟體工程師發布了緊急安全性修補程式以修復安全漏洞。

examples.en: The committee fixed the date of the annual general meeting for October 15th.
examples.zh: 委員會將年度會員大會的舉辦日期固定訂在十月十五日。

examples.en: Set your home air conditioner to 26°C with an electric fan for energy saving.
examples.zh: 將家中冷氣溫度設定在 26 度並搭配電風扇以節約能源。

examples.en: Cleaning the dust filters of the air conditioner improves cooling efficiency.
examples.zh: 定期清洗冷氣機濾網能大幅提升冷房降溫效率。

examples.en: An inverter air conditioner maintains a consistent room temperature while using less power.
examples.zh: 變頻冷暖空調在耗費更少電力的同時能維持恆定的室溫。

examples.en: A high-efficiency dehumidifier is essential in humid northern Taiwan winters.
examples.zh: 在潮濕的北台灣冬季，一台高效率除濕機是不可或缺的家電。

examples.en: Empty the water collection tank of the dehumidifier once it becomes full.
examples.zh: 當集水箱裝滿水時，請將除濕機的儲水箱倒空。

examples.en: Running a dehumidifier helps prevent mold from growing on wooden wardrobes and books.
examples.zh: 運轉除濕機能有效防止木製衣櫃與書籍發霉長斑。

examples.en: An air purifier with a HEPA filter filters out fine PM2.5 dust particles.
examples.zh: 配備 HEPA 濾網的空氣清淨機能有效過濾 PM2.5 細懸浮微粒。

examples.en: People with respiratory allergies benefit greatly from keeping an air purifier in the bedroom.
examples.zh: 患有呼吸道過敏的人在臥室擺放一台空氣清淨機會大有裨益。

examples.en: The digital display on the air purifier shows real-time indoor air quality metrics.
examples.zh: 空氣清淨機上的數位顯示面板能即時呈現室內空氣品質數值。

examples.en: Make sure the digital gas water heater is installed with outdoor ventilation.
examples.zh: 確保數位瓦斯熱水器安裝於通風良好的室外陽台。

examples.en: A faulty water heater left us taking freezing cold showers this morning.
examples.zh: 故障的熱水器讓我們今天早晨被迫洗了一場冰冷刺骨的冷水澡。

examples.en: Turn down the temperature setting on your water heater to prevent accidental scalding.
examples.zh: 調低熱水器的溫度設定以防意外燙傷。

examples.en: The small bedroom feels warm, quiet, and cozy during winter.
examples.zh: 這間小臥室在冬天讓人感到溫暖、寧靜且溫馨愜意。

examples.en: We sat in a cozy corner of the vintage cafe reading novels and sipping tea.
examples.zh: 我們坐在這家復古咖啡館溫馨的一角看小說、喝熱茶。

examples.en: Put on a pair of cozy fleece slippers after kicking off your work boots.
examples.zh: 脫下工作皮靴後，換上一雙暖和舒適的刷毛室內拖鞋。

examples.en: This memory foam mattress provides a comfortable night's sleep.
examples.zh: 這款記憶棉床墊能提供整晚極致舒適的睡眠品質。

examples.en: Wear loose, comfortable clothing when taking long-distance international flights.
examples.zh: 搭乘長途跨國長途航班時，請穿著寬鬆舒適的衣物。

examples.en: Are you feeling comfortable with the proposed project timeline?
examples.zh: 您對目前擬議中的專案執行時程感到自在滿意嗎？
